critical_code_review_comments: displayList useMemo in Revenue.jsx iterates rows twice (once to build groups, once to emit). Minor; fine for 381 entries. Could be O(n) single pass but not blocking.

Sticky top header + bottom nav overlap can intercept pointer events on items that scroll under them (Playwright flagged this during click retry). Not caused by this feature, but any future test using raw .click() on list items near viewport edges may flake — JS-level click or scroll adjustment works around it.
